benchmarks.name: OSWorld 2.1 — Binary Accuracy
benchmarks.description: Binary task completion on OSWorld-V2 release osworld-v2.1, requiring matched code, task classes, assets, mocked websites and provider images. Full and offline scopes and step budgets remain separate results; historical 2.0 releases are excluded.

benchmarks.name: OSWorld 2.1 — Partial Score
benchmarks.description: Checkpoint-based partial score, distinct from binary completion; explicitly labeled OSWorld 2.1 observations only. Release osworld-v2.1 pins matching task and asset revisions; vendor observations without component pins retain that missing condition and cannot be approved. No gated task contents were collected.

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench 1.0.6 — strict pass rate
benchmarks.description: Zapier original held-out private leaderboard: task_completed_correctly, every assertion must pass. Not public-set scores, partial_credit, or AutomationBench-AA objective completion. Multi-model fallback rows are excluded from single-model results.

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam — original accuracy
benchmarks.description: Original 2,500-question HLE, not HLE-Rolling, HLE-preview or HLE-Diamond. Tool access and full/text subset must be distinguished per experiment; missing row-level metadata remains unknown. Scores with refused questions served by another model are system-only.

benchmarks.name: Chartography — accuracy
benchmarks.description: Professional chart understanding. Official public harness revision 3f1bf837232d3918c2cc35c6e2418c9e70d2a57b documents 100 expert-authored tasks, Inspect AI accuracy/mean, ten runs/task and Gemini 3.5 Flash judge. This pins harness code, NOT the task dataset or every vendor run. Benchmark version and task revision remain unknown; package version 0.1.0 is not a benchmark version. Tool-enabled and no-tools vendor observations remain separate with unknown configuration blocked in unrepresentedConditions.

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam — original text-only, Artificial Analysis
benchmarks.description: Artificial Analysis independent evaluation of 2,158 text-only questions from original HLE May 2025 revision (day not specified), excluding multimodal questions. Raw embedded hle fractions are retained without converting to percent; separate from hleDiamond and from full-set official runs. Equality checker GPT-5.6 Luna (medium), pass@1.
